name: RAW DATA SPLITTER
description: Cleans the Raw Data sheet of a booking file and splits it into NFEI YES and FedEx booking workbooks.

name: ARAMEX AUTOMATION
description: Fills Aramex shipment templates for Dubai and Saudi (bulk and customer) bookings.

name: VELOCITY AUTOMATION
description: Consolidates a Booking file into one Singapore tax invoice (Bulk, B2B, DO or OwnDays source).

name: DHL AUTOMATION
description: Builds DHL shipment files for Singapore, OWNDAYS Singapore and Thailand bulk bookings.

name: FEDEX AUTOMATION
description: Splits a FedEx booking export into the US and Non-US FBT batch upload templates.

name: SAUDI BULK BOOKING
description: Cleans a Saudi bulk-booking file, adds Aramex AWBs and builds the booking workbook.

name: THAILAND BULK BOOKING
description: Cleans a Thailand bulk-booking file, converts declared value from THB to USD and builds the booking workbook.
